loops.minute_1: Dart Monkey initial placement near map start, cash bootstrap (~650$ starting), exploration of tower placement zones, first enemy wave engagement (Red Bloons, speed ~1 cell/sec).
loops.minute_10: Banana Farm economy established for cash momentum, Dart upgrade path chosen (Sharp Shots or Razor Sharp), mid-map tower positions filled (support roles), first waves cleared with modest pressure.
loops.hour_5: Late-game MOAB introduction (rounds 63+), tower tier 4-5 unlocked, farming loops mature generating 5-10k$ per round, ceramic rushes appear (multi-layer enemies), specialization critical (mage piercing, artillery splash).
loops.endgame: Freeplay rounds 140+ with randomized Bloons, super-ceramic rushes, money-per-pop degraded, gameplay shifts to strategic theater (show off optimized setups), endless potential if economy sustains.

objectives.victory_condition: Survive 60 rounds and eliminate final BFB (Boss Bloon) without any Bloon reaching end of map.
objectives.defeat_condition: Any Bloon reaches end of map (leaks) — instant loss.
objectives.player_goal: Manage tower placement, upgrades, and economy to repel escalating Bloon waves within 60 rounds.
Survive indefinite randomized waves (140+) for score/achievement chasing and strategic optimization display.

games.retention_answer: Bloons TD 6 retains players through layered progression (early/mid/late game distinct phases), dual upgrade paths (each tower replayable differently), farming loops rewarding patience/optimization, hero additions (active tactilidad), and endless content post-campaign. Cosmetics avoid pay-to-win, aligning monetization with mastery.

loops.minute_1: Sunflower planted to initiate sun generation (timer-based, passive income), 1-2 basic damage plants placed (Peashooter), manual sun collection (tap before despawn), basic zombie lane threat engagement.
loops.minute_10: Sun flow stabilized (50-100 accumulation mid-wave), mid-wave zombie type apparent (Buckethead, etc.), plant counter-selection active (fire vs ice zombie specialization), energy (sun limit) forces tough placement choices.
loops.hour_5: Progression into higher-difficulty worlds (Desert, Modern Day themes), special level types (Last Stand = no sun regen, fixed resource), Zomboss encounters (boss-final-level per world), plant leveling stats visible (20-30 upgrades).
loops.endgame: Post-campaign repeatable events (Timed Events, Piñata Parties weekly scoring), Zombosseum gladiator mode, infinite plant leveling (+40 stats soft cap), costume cosmetics unlocked, leaderboard PvP ranking.

objectives.victory_condition: Eliminate all zombie waves in a level without any Zombie reaching and eating the player's brain.
objectives.defeat_condition: Any Zombie reaches the left edge (brain) and consumes it — instant level loss.
objectives.player_goal: Deploy plants strategically using sun economy to repel themed zombie waves across 40+ Adventure levels and 8 Worlds.

objectives.victory_condition: Survive all zombie waves using only starting sun allotment (fixed, no regen) — typically 3-5 waves per level.
objectives.defeat_condition: Zombie reaches brain OR sun depleted with no plants to defend.
objectives.player_goal: Optimize plant selection and placement under strict resource constraint (one-time sun pool, no income).

objectives.victory_condition: Complete themed challenge levels (5-wave climbs) within time window (typically 2-3 weeks per event) to unlock exclusive plants/cosmetics.
objectives.defeat_condition: Zombie reaches brain OR event time expires.
objectives.player_goal: Grind themed events daily for seed packet rewards and limited-edition plants (retention trigger).

games.retention_answer: Plants vs Zombies 2 retains through daily/weekly forced re-engagement (Timed Events, Tasks, Piñata scoring), 50+ plant variety preventing repetition staleness, cosmetics (costumes, variants) enabling self-expression, optional ad-watching monetization lowering spending barrier, and themed Worlds (visual refresh per 8 levels). Plant leveling compression (grind vs spend) accommodates casual and hardcore.

loops.minute_1: First tower selection (Archer default choice, generalist, modest cost), chokepoint identification on map geometry, initial tower placement into restricted slots (not free canvas), Wave 1 (weak goblin/zombie weak enemies) rolls in.
loops.minute_10: Wave 3-5, first enemy type hard counter visible (Mage needed vs armored, Barracks for melee block), tower upgrade tier 1-2 purchased (Bombs, Reinforcements, Meteors prioritized), gold flow ~400-600 from enemy kills.
loops.hour_5: Campaign mid-stage (level 8-12 of 17), 8-12 waves per level, boss spawns (unique multi-stage enemies), tower tier 3-4 unlocked, star economy mature (next-level upgrades planned from past-level star earnings), special enemy combo waves (simultaneous Ogre+Thief).
loops.endgame: Post-campaign Endless Mode (infinite waves, 2% stat scaling per enemy spawn), hero leveling XP, Iron Challenge races (zero-tolerance skill proofs), wave 150+ HP/damage math breaks without optimized tower synergy, cosmetic unlocks.

objectives.victory_condition: Clear all enemy waves on a campaign level (12-17 levels per campaign) without losing 20 lives.
objectives.defeat_condition: Lives counter reaches zero (enemies leak threshold met).
objectives.player_goal: Strategically place towers in fixed slots, manage tower synergies (Barracks tank + Archer dps + Mage armor pen), and repel all waves per level.

objectives.defeat_condition: Lives reach zero (start 10 lives, waves infinite with 2% stat escalation).
objectives.player_goal: Survive indefinite waves with no level exit, optimizing tower synergy and economy as enemies scale infinitely.

objectives.victory_condition: Clear campaign level on Veteran difficulty with ZERO tower damage and ZERO lives lost (maximum star multiplier).
objectives.defeat_condition: Any tower takes damage OR any life lost (no lives to lose).
objectives.player_goal: Execute perfect defense for cosmetic/achievement proof of mastery (pure skill gate, no relaxed progression).

games.retention_answer: Kingdom Rush retains through star-gated tower upgrades (past-level skill enables future-level power, motivation to replay for 3-star clears), enemy type introduction per level (novelty + learning curve), fixed tower placement (mastery through constraint, not spam), Endless mode and difficulty tiers (Normal/Veteran/Impossible) extending content indefinitely, and Iron Challenges gatekeeping cosmetics behind zero-tolerance skill. Hero leveling persists across campaigns, and tower synergy depth (Barracks blocks, Archer dps, Mage armor pen) rewards planning.
